text:
Sara (CS): forwarding an urgent escal from Acme (Janelle). After last night's rollout customers are seeing function/tool-calling regressions — wrong args returned and sometimes no tool call at all. Customer has a live flow that used to reliably call our `charge_customer` tool; now it returns a text response or calls the wrong function name. Repro attached.

Janelle (Acme): happening in prod since ~00:30 UTC. Example request: 
```http
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
{
  "model": "redwood-infer-2026-04",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Charge order 123 for $49.99"}],
  "functions": [{"name": "charge_customer", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}}}}],
  "function_call": "auto"
}
```

Expected: model returns a function call to `charge_customer` with args `{\"order_id\": \"123\", \"amount\": 49.99}`
Observed: sometimes returns plain text: "I can help with that, please confirm card" OR calls `create_charge` (internal legacy name) with malformed args (amount as string).

Sara (CS): customer tried pinning to older model and said regressions stopped. They rolled back to `redwood-infer-2026-03` and behavior returned to normal.

Kai (Eng): pinging. Any rollout changes this morning? Did we change default function_call policy or postprocessing?

Oliver (Prod): we promoted canary `redwood-infer-2026-04` at 23:45 UTC. No other runtime changes noted. There was a small change in model mapping: alias `redwood-infer-2026` now points to the new variant.

Maria (SRE): I'm collecting request IDs from the customer. Janelle, can you share a failing request_id or the full request body + response headers? We need to trace through router and runtime.

Janelle (Acme): pasted a couple request_ids in DM: r-202603150032-ao1, r-202603150049-bx3. Attaching one full response: 

```json
{
  "id": "r-202603150032-ao1",
  "status": "200",
  "response": {"choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Sure, I can take care of that. What card?"}}]}
}
```

Kai (Eng): interesting — the model returned assistant content instead of `function_call`. Two hypotheses: 1) model-level behavior change in how it decides to emit function call vs text; 2) our pre/post-processing that maps model outputs to function calls broke for the new variant (e.g., renamed `function_call.name` field or changed schema).

Kai (Eng): steps I'll take: (a) reproduce locally by hitting the canary model with same messages/functions, (b) enable verbose kernel-level logs to see `function_call` tokens, (c) compare tokenizer and sampling params between variants.

Sara (CS): customer says the incorrect call to `create_charge` happens ~10% of the time and text fallback ~30% on the new model, vs ~1% on the pinned older model. They're very unhappy. Escalation wants timeline and rollback plan.

Oliver (Prod): suggest immediate partial rollback of alias mapping to reduce impact. How quickly can we revert alias?

Maria (SRE): deploy-bot, create incident P2 and page on-call for eng-runtime and model-onboarding.

deploy-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-213, severity P2. Notifying eng-runtime on-call.

Kai (Eng): I have a repro curl (local) that reproduces the missing function_call ~60% for me when using `redwood-infer-2026-04`. Pasting snippet: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json
# payload.json is the same as Acme's request body
```

Kai (Eng): here's the truncated model tokens I observed (function_call token sequence is absent): 
```
... <assistant> I can help with that </assistant> ...
```

Kai (Eng): running comparison of the decoding logits now. If the model variant emits different token preferences for the "\"name\": \"function_call\"" shape, our parser won't pick it up.

Oliver (Prod): temporary mitigation: set customer alias to explicitly point to `redwood-infer-2026-03` OR set `function_call` enforcement in the router for pinned customers (force `function_call": {"behavior": "force"}`) — does that exist?

Maria (SRE): we have a routing policy flag `force_function_call=true` but it's undocumented and risky. If engineering can confirm safety we can toggle per-customer.

Kai (Eng): I'll test `force_function_call` in staging and report. If it blocks non-function outputs at the router layer we can flip it for Acme temporarily.

Sara (CS): customer requests: 1) rollback alias for all Acme traffic within 30m, 2) postmortem within 72h, 3) compensation conversation with AM.

Kai (Eng): root cause guess so far: model variant A introduced a subtle change in tokenization/format for function calls (maybe changed templating). Could also be we accidentally stripped the `function_call` tokens in our postprocessing when model returned unusual spans. Need to diff raw logits.

Oliver (Prod): I'm scheduling a rollback window at 00:15 UTC if engineering confirms. Please update this thread with test results.

Kai (Eng): quick repro result — I forced `force_function_call=true` for my request and the router injected a synthetic function_call wrapper based on intent detection. That produced `charge_customer` with correct args. This suggests router-layer mitigation is viable immediately. But we should treat as stopgap.

Maria (SRE): toggled `force_function_call=true` for Acme in the router config. Monitoring metrics.

deploy-bot: Config change applied to route acme.com -> router-5 at 00:09 UTC.

Janelle (Acme): seeing immediate improvement, thanks. A few calls still mis-classified but much better.

Kai (Eng): next steps for eng: 1) collect model token stream diffs for variants 2026-03 vs 2026-04 (assigned to Kai), 2) audit postprocessing parser for edge-case token shapes (assigned to Kai + Oliver), 3) produce hotfix to alias mapping rollback automation (assigned to Oliver), 4) write runbook entry for `force_function_call` usage (Maria + Kai).

Sara (CS): I'll coordinate customer comms and set expectation for a postmortem.

Maria (SRE): monitoring shows error-rate for function call misfires dropped from 28% -> 6% for Acme after flip. Keep an eye on any side effects.

Kai (Eng): logging notes: capture raw model token stream and router pre/post mapping for the two request_ids Janelle provided. Also capture any sampling param differences (temp, top_p).

Oliver (Prod): if we confirm model is root cause, we need to revert the model alias for all customers until we can ship a compatibility patch. That is a heavier decision — product to weigh.

Sara (CS): noted. I'll compile a timeline and set a 72h postmortem deadline.

Kai (Eng): attaching command to pull logs: 
```bash
redwood logs fetch --request-id r-202603150032-ao1 --include model_tokens,router_trace --out tokens_r-202603150032.json
```

Kai (Eng): will post diffs here when done.

(End of thread)
